title: metamodel-aasChangeEventCompact.v1
description: Compact metamodel-aligned schema for Asset Administration Shell change events. The AAS identifier is a plain string (AssetAdministrationShell.id), which is structurally identical to the non-metamodel compact variant. Included for symmetry and documentation purposes.

aasId.description: Identifier of the AAS (URI). Corresponds to AssetAdministrationShell.id in the AAS metamodel. Plain string, not a Reference, since identifiers in the AAS metamodel are scalar strings.
